# Tile types

Every tile registered in `src/world/tiles/Tiles.lua`. **Id** is stored in the level's `tiles` grid (see
`src/world/tiles/TileCodec.lua` for the raw cell format: id + water + spikes). Global `TILE_<NAME>` = its id.

| Id | Name | Label | Category | Collision | Material | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `empty` | Vacío | Básicos | none | default |  |
| 1 | `solid` | Piedra | Terreno | solid | stone | joins `ground` |
| 2 | `platform` | Plataforma | Plataformas | oneway | stone | partial hitbox |
| 3 | `danger` | Lava | Peligros | none | deadly | gives light |
| 4 | `border` | Borde | Terreno | solid | stone | joins `ground` |
| 9 | `water` | Agua | Líquidos | none | water |  |

## Materials

`src/world/tiles/materials/<name>.lua`: ash, basalt, deadly, deep_stone, default, dirt, grass, ice, sand, snow, stone, water, wood.
